2 ظلّمهُ , inf. n. تَظْلِيمٌ, (T, S, &c.,) He told him that he was ظَالِم [i. e. doing wrong or acting wrongfully &c., or a wrongdoer]: (T:) or he attributed, or imputed, to him ظُلْم [i. e. wrongdoing, &c.]. (S, M, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- And He (a judge) exacted justice for him from his wronger, and aided him against him. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
